arguments.file_text:
# hvir

A lightweight, view-first workbench for agentic development.

hvir is an Electron desktop app that pairs fast, GPU-accelerated terminals with file viewing, git tooling, and session awareness — built for working alongside coding agents on local and remote (SSH) projects.

## Features

- **Terminals** — [ghostty-web](https://github.com/jarmak-personal/ghostty-web)–based terminal panes with splits, moves, themes, and lifecycle management, backed by native PTYs (`node-pty`).
- **View-first workbench** — file tree, syntax-highlighted viewer (Shiki), Markdown rendering with Mermaid diagrams, HTML preview, and an embedded web pane.
- **Git integration** — repository status, diffs (CodeMirror merge view), and document review workflows.
- **Remote workspaces** — open projects on remote hosts over SSH (`ssh2`, SSH config aware).
- **Sessions & harness profiles** — agent session projection, harness telemetry/usage, and attention badges so you know when a terminal needs you.
- **Cross-platform packaging** — macOS (pkg) and Linux (deb) builds via electron-builder.

## Requirements

- Node.js >= 24
- Build toolchain for native modules (node-gyp: Python, C/C++ compiler)

## Getting started

```bash
npm install        # also rebuilds native modules for Electron
npm run dev        # start in development mode
```

## Building

```bash
npm run build              # typecheck + production build
npm run build:dir          # unpacked app directory
npm run pack:mac:arm64     # macOS arm64 pkg
npm run pack:linux:x64     # Linux x64 deb
```

## Development

| Command | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `npm run verify` | Full gate: seams, ADRs, architecture, lint, typecheck, tests |
| `npm test` | Unit tests (Vitest) |
| `npm run lint` | ESLint |
| `npm run format` | Prettier |
| `npm run typecheck` | TypeScript (node + web) |
| `npm run smoke` | Build and run smoke scenarios |
| `npm run test:mutation` | Mutation testing (Stryker) |
| `npm run hooks:install` | Install git hooks |

### Project layout

```
src/
  main/       Electron main process (git, pty, ssh, sessions, viewer, ...)
  preload/    Preload bridge
  renderer/   React UI (terminals, viewer, git, layout, settings, ...)
  shared/     IPC contracts and shared types
  workers/    Worker processes
scripts/      Build, smoke, acceptance, and project-management tooling
test/         Test suites
```

## License

[MIT](LICENSE) — see also [THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md](THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md).
